#### Issue description

* *Expected behavior:* (What you expect to happen)

* *Actual behavior:* (What actually happens)

* *Reproduces how often:* (Every time, or only sometimes?)

#### Where it happens

* *YourTube version:* (shown on your browser's extensions page)

* *Browser and version:*

* *YouTube site:* (www.youtube.com, m.youtube.com, or a video embedded on another website)

* *Logged in to YouTube:* (yes / no)

#### Additional information

Screenshots, browser console messages starting with `[YourTube]`, the settings you have on, or
anything else that helps reproduce the issue.
